what: In the curtain covering the hero, 21 vertical bars of the logo fall from above the screen, each on its own, and stand as a sound-wave-shaped logo. Each bar draws a random duration of 0~.8s and delay of 0~1.2s, with circ.out for the bottom position and circ.inOut for the height at 1.5× that duration (0.2× later). At 2.7s the bar color changes over 1s, and at 4.7s the curtain lifts over 1.2s with circ.out

options.[data-fx-part=bar]: Bars (several, required) — horizontal position by left:% in style, height behind the line and floor (px) by data-h and data-b, on phone data-hsp and data-bsp
options.tint: When the bar color changes (sec), default 2.7
options.hold: Time the curtain starts lifting (s), default 4.7 — shorten if the screen is skipped often
options.bp: Width (px) at which it switches to phone values (data-hsp·bsp), default 768
options.--fx-bar · --fx-tint: Bar start color · changed color (via style), default --kf-accent · --kf-ink
options.fx:done: Fires once the curtain is fully lifted

use: …

from.where: index.html .bh-loading (original home.bundle — .loading__logo 21 spans, TweenMax.to(bottom: data-btm, .8×rand, delay 1.2×rand, Circ.easeOut) · to(height: data-h, 1.5×, delay +.2×, Circ.easeInOut), is-color-change at 2700ms, .loading autoAlpha 0 1.2 Circ.easeOut at 4700ms)
